title: про-: through, past, and a distance covered

blocks.text: The prefix "про-" implies the following meanings: a) Going through — через + Acc.: Мы проехали через лес. b) Passing by — мимо + Gen.: Мы прошли мимо вашего дома. c) Passing between — между + Instr.: Войска противника прошли между лесом и рекой. d) Covering a distance — verb + Acc.: Они прошли два километра. e) Passing (missing) a place or leaving it behind — verb + Acc.: Мы проехали нашу станцию. (missed it) Мы уже проехали этот город. (left it behind) Notice also the following expressions: Прошла неделя. — A week went by. Дождь прошёл. — The rain stopped.

head: prefix / primary meanings
examples / additional meanings
prepositional phrases
rows: **про-** — Movement across, through, or past something

Мы проехали через город. — We drove through the city. Мы прошли мимо станции метро. — We passed the metro station. Other: 1. Movement beyond one's destination (possibly unintentional): Я боюсь, что мы уже прошли магазин. — I'm afraid we already passed the store. 2. Movement forward with the distance covered specified: Вы проедете три остановки и выйдете из трамвая. — You'll go three stops and get off the tram.
сквозь / через / в + acc.; мимо + gen.; without preposition
**про-** (temporal) — Prolonged multidirectional movement, with multidirectional verb of motion
Мы проходили по лесу весь день. — We walked around the woods all day.

blocks.text: Проводить — провести — to lead through, to spend (time), to lay (a road). Note the expression: "проводить время" — to spend the time.

items: How do you spend your time?
Мы провели в Европе два месяца.
We spent two months in Europe.
В прошлом году здесь провели несколько новых дорог.
They built several new roads here last year.

head: perfective
imperfective
Wiktionary's definition
rows: to pass, to go, to walk; to pass by
to go through/by (by horse or vehicle), to ride through/by, to drive through/by; to drive past/along/across
to fly (by, past, through), to fly (over); to overfly, to overshoot
to run past, to run through; to run a certain distance or for some time
to swim by, to float by, to sail by; to swim (a certain distance or time), to sail (a certain distance or time)
to carry (by, past, through), to smuggle, to sneak; (impersonal, colloquial)
to lead, to conduct, to guide, to steer, to take; to lay, to construct, to build, to install a road, a pipe, a wire etc.
